topics.title: Howard Calls His Wife About Florida
topics.summary: After watching coverage of the plane crash, Howard calls his wife about canceling her Florida trip. They talk about staying home in the snow, the cleaning woman's arrival, and the apartment before a video rental promotion.

topics.title: Greatest News Hits and Concert Ticket Callers
topics.summary: A greatest-news-hits routine revisits the end of World War II, the moon landing, and Nixon's resignation as upbeat alternatives to the day's tragedies. The broadcast returns to airport safety, school closures, and callers competing for Police concert tickets.

topics.title: School Closures Sung to Rock Music
topics.summary: Robin arrives after a neighbor helps open her frozen car door. With Fred on guitar, the school closure list becomes an All Closed Now singalong, followed by a debate about dwelling on the plane and subway crashes.

topics.title: The Cleaning Woman and Crash Coverage
topics.summary: Robin challenges Howard over expecting his cleaning woman to travel in the snow. Howard says hiring her helped his marriage, then the conversation turns to television coverage of the plane crash and viewers' appetite for its details.

topics.title: Robin's Shark Documentary and Tonight's TV
topics.summary: Robin describes a shark documentary featuring a protective steel suit. The television rundown covers PBS programming and Barbara Walters' interviews, followed by a preview of Fred's report on chaperoning a Dial-A-Date.

topics.title: Carl Sagan Calls and Johnny Carson in Bed
topics.summary: A caller does a Carl Sagan impression about Leave It to Beaver. Robin reads a story about temporary vision trouble after watching television in bed, prompting jokes about Johnny Carson and romantic encounters interrupted by TV or Neil Young.
